fixed_package.hash_order: sha256(canonical lowercase hexadecimal state bitmask), ascending
fixed_package.task_rule: joint: sha256(case_id)-first available n6 and n8 case; IPC: pre-existing p06,p11,p12,p14,p15,p17 scope cases
missing_categories: IPC p21/p22 historical time-cutoff large graphs have no scope parent package; p17 is largest accessible selected graph; no new states collected

search.goal_check: root then each generated successor in canonical action order
search.batch_order: all new successors scored before insertion; no microbenchmark truncation in search

numeric.source: inherited FAST PLAN_ATOL/PLAN_RTOL; do not relax post hoc
numeric.scatter_atomic_nondeterminism: record F repeat differences; not bitwise equivalence

benchmark.grouped_output: successor scores only; incremental parent full recomputation and cache lifetime charged; F batches successors normally
benchmark.interleaved: round-robin one successor from each parent; contiguous windows of <=48 requests; parent-cache LRU capacity 2; no tuning
benchmark.gpu_external_load: other compute PIDs on selected GPU invalidates paired block; maximum one repeat replacement; retain all attempts

gates.G1: exact update path plus representative avoidable computation; no off-the-shelf complete scorer adaptation already verified
gates.G2: no stale cache/nonfinite/unexplained tolerance failure, exact mathematical correspondence and complete accounting
gates.G3: task geometric mean full-request speedup >=1.20, gain in >=2 strata, reasonable memory/noise
